svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The Open Graph image spec: a 1200 by 630 pixel canvas at a 1.91 to 1 aspect ratio, which Facebook, LinkedIn, Slack, Discord, and X's large card all crop cleanly. Keep logos and text inside a centred safe zone with roughly 60 pixels of padding, because some platforms crop the edges. Below the minimum 600 by 315, platforms fall back to a small square thumbnail.
svg.text: safe zone — keep logo & text inside (~60px padding)
Cropped cleanly by Facebook · LinkedIn · Slack · Discord · X (large card)
to a small square thumbnail next
to the text — not the big card.
Ship these and previews look right almost everywhere:
• Dimensions 1200 × 630 (min 600 × 315) • Format PNG or JPG • Under ~5 MB (WhatsApp caps ~300 KB)
• Use an absolute og:image URL • Set og:image:width/height so the first scrape sizes it right
• X: add twitter:card = summary_large_image or you get the small square instead of the 1.91:1 card
